settings.eligibility: Full_Q greedy answer correct and margin(true - alt) > 0
settings.blind_filter: not eligible if the same rule passes on a blank of the padding colour at the real image's size
settings.pool: manifest items whose latest current-digest decision is pass, in manifest order
settings.shortfall: fewer than main_size eligible after the whole pool is screened: the main set is every eligible item, the control subset its first control_size, and the shortfall is reported
